components.title: Secret redaction utility
components.description: Pure utility that masks API keys and credential-like substrings in arbitrary text before persistence or rendering. Used by the moments engine.
components.reviewFindings:
## Review Findings

**12 passed, 0 failed, 0 advisory**

- [pass] Anthropic, OpenAI, AWS, GitHub PAT, and JWT-shaped tokens are replaced with [REDACTED]
- [pass] Each provider regex is covered by at least one unit test with a representative key
- [pass] Typecheck passes
- [pass] Tests pass
- [pass] Any sequence of >= 20 alnum/`_`/`-` characters appearing after the literals key, token, secret, or password (case-insensitive) is replaced with [REDACTED]
- [pass] Plain English text containing those words but no high-entropy tail is left unchanged
- [pass] Typecheck passes
- [pass] Tests pass
- [pass] Running the redactor twice on the same input produces the same output as one run
- [pass] Already-redacted [REDACTED] markers are not duplicated or split
- [pass] Typecheck passes
- [pass] Tests pass

**Notes**: All three stories are cleanly implemented in a single small module (praxis/redactor.py) with focused, well-named tests. The (pattern, replacement) tuple design lets the labeled-secret rule preserve the label via backref while keeping a single-pass fold. Idempotence is preserved as a structural invariant (value classes exclude `[`, tail length 20 > len('REDACTED')=8) rather than via post-processing, which is the right call.
